title: Way too expensive
body: I can’t believe a reading app can charge more than $1 per chapter that you read in 3 minutes. Deleting this :(

title: Good story but…..
body: I was really enjoying the story I was reading but it is way too expensive to buy chapters. I guess this will be one app I delete

title: Good stories, Bad prices
body: The story I tried was well written but $30 to read 28 chapters with 300 in the book is entirely to expensive even with rewards it's not something I can afford. So I'm going to have to say no thanks.
